newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt share prices fall in solid trade.
newsitem.headline: Egypt share prices fall in solid trade.

text.p: The Cairo share index on Tuesday eased to its lowest level this month on slack prices, but volume was supported by solid trade in Egyptian American Bank (EAB).
Nearly half of all the traded shares fell and the index came to rest at 345.85 points, its lowest level since the beginning of the month, relinquishing 1.99 points.
"There is a lack of new big deals," said Sherif Cararah of EFG Hermes. He said one factor could be that retail investors are selling because they want liquidity.
The Capital Market Authority (CMA) said volume was an above average 84 million pounds ($24.7 million), with trade in EAB worth about 10 million pounds.
The bank's share closed steady at 120 pounds.

"It's most likely to be institutional buying," said Tarek Lotfy at Intercapital Securities. "People who thought the stock was too expensive when it was offered think 120 pounds is a good price and so they're probably buying now."

More than 319,000 shares in the bank were sold this week by the Egyptian state's Bank of Alexandria at 127 pounds per share. The offer of 1.2 million shares was oversubscribed at 110 to 112 pounds per share, brokers said.
Heliopolis Housing and Development also put in a strong showing with 4.3 million pounds of trade. Its share rose two pounds to 420.
Egyptian Financial and Industrial was the third most active share. It notched up a slim 0.5 pounds to 202.5.
"I expected to see a lot of volume in the blue chip shares," said Cararah.
In the milling sector, Central and West Delta Flour Mills saw relatively high trade of 3.7 million pounds. Its share price continued to fall and on Tuesday shed 1.48 pounds to 78.5 pounds.
The best cement performer was Amriyah Cement, with two million pounds changing hands. The share price slipped 0.12 pound to 82.3.
The index for openly traded firms fell to 471.38 points from 475.33 points on Monday and that for the rarely traded "closed" firms fell to 256.39 from 257.54 points.
Of the 85 shares traded, 20 rose, 47 fell while 18 ended unchanged, the CMA said.
